artifact: BaoIAD v1.0.0 to v1.1.0 compatibility contract

registry.contract: Registry definitions retain MMEngine locations for lazy discovery; importing baoiad stays lightweight and explicit registration remains available.

migrations.from: Repository-local data paths embedded in base configurations.
migrations.to: BAOIAD_DATA_ROOT with the repository data directory as the fallback.
migrations.compatibility: Existing repository-relative layouts continue to resolve through the fallback.

migrations.from: Legacy pickle checkpoints were loaded without an explicit trust boundary.
migrations.to: Restricted loading is the default and verified legacy pickle files require --trusted-checkpoint.
migrations.compatibility: Trusted legacy checkpoints remain loadable through an explicit opt-in.

migrations.from: RegAD could rely on a locally reconstructed support set.
migrations.to: strict_require_official_support_set=True makes the official support set mandatory.
migrations.compatibility: The deterministic fallback remains the default unless strict mode is selected.

migrations.from: Exact upstream sample order was not represented as a verified external input.
migrations.compatibility: Standard ViTAD configuration paths remain available; exact-order mode is explicit.

known_breaks.rationale: The organization release is verified on Python 3.10 and 3.12.

known_breaks.impact: The core dependency changes from mmcv to mmcv-lite.
known_breaks.rationale: The packaged core does not require compiled MMCV operators.

known_breaks.impact: faiss-gpu, imgaug, mamba, and mmpretrain extras are no longer declared.
known_breaks.rationale: Only release-tested dependency groups remain in public package metadata.

known_breaks.impact: Unverified pickle checkpoints no longer load implicitly.
known_breaks.rationale: Explicit trust is required because pickle deserialization can execute code.

known_breaks.impact: Strict RegAD and exact-order ViTAD runs require verified external artifacts.
known_breaks.rationale: BaoIAD does not fabricate or redistribute missing upstream support/order assets.

release_rationale: Version 1.1.0 does not rewrite the historical v1.0.0 tag whose package metadata is 0.1.0.
The retained source roots and legacy CLI flags preserve the primary integration surface.
Intentional breaks are limited to security, clean-install portability, and strict reproducibility boundaries.
